topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I can't help but notice the tightness that grips me when the words are spoken. The取消的惊喜派对, it doesn't sit right. All that anticipation, the thrill of what could have been, now just...nothing. I try to muster some casual response, but the air feels thick and heavy around me. People are saying it's for the best, that something came up. But I can't shake the hollow feeling inside, the sense that something is lost, perhaps forever. I nod, even as the edges of my vision blur a bit, the noise around me dulling to a distant hum. I tell myself it’s just a party, but it’s hard to believe that when everything inside feels so off.
